#!/bin/bash
# 夜间测试脚本 - S4标准实现
# 用于定时长时间运行测试

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_DIR="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
LOG_FILE="$PROJECT_DIR/reports/nightly_test_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).log"

# 确保报告目录存在
mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR/reports"

# 颜色定义
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $1" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

log_info() {
    log "${GREEN}INFO${NC}: $1"
}
